# Core validation scripts use the Python standard library only.
# Real-data fetch adapters also use the standard library; if certifi is
# installed, HTTPS certificate validation uses it to fix local CA path issues.
# Optional runtime add-ons:
# - certifi: improves HTTPS CA discovery on local machines with incomplete CA paths.
# - pdfplumber: enables A-share and HK official PDF financial-report line extraction.
# Keep this file comment-only unless the whole skill truly requires a dependency.
